entities.summary: Regla Maritza Bell MacKenzie is one of the great legends of Cuban and world volleyball. A left-handed attacker of tremendous power and charisma, she was a key figure in the Cuban national team known as “Las Espectaculares Morenas del Caribe”, the squad that dominated women’s world volleyball in the 1990s and early 2000s.
